messages:
elaine: Montclair weekly health check — quick snapshot. TL;DR: tokens -8% WoW, +14% QoQ (marketing push). p95 180ms, p99 240ms (+60ms WoW). Error rate at 0.9% (was 0.2%) — mostly timeouts on long contexts. Spend +22% QoQ. Sharing notes and action items.

sam: digging into logs — spike at 12:15 UTC, decoder OOMs on long sequences (>5k). kv-cache pressure looks likely.

jorge: theyre on dedicated A100 pool with RTP profile, suspect batching + long-ctx interactions. pinging @infra-bot for autoscale/recent node events.

infra-bot: Autoscale event: 2026-03-20T12:17Z — added 2 nodes to montclair-prod-pool. GPU mem avg 88%. Event: scale_up/triggered. Link: https://dash.redwood/infra/events/abc

katie: renewal note — execs are happy with adoption but concerned about cost increase. Scheduling enablement + cost review call Wed 4pm PT. Will prioritize latency improvements. :calendar:

sam: quick experiments to try today: 1) reduce max_batch_size 64->32 for requests with ctx >2k; 2) enable prefix cache for welcome flows; 3) fall back to quantized-v2 for non-critical paths. Config snippet:```yaml
routes:
  - id: welcome_flow
    max_batch: 32
    cache: prefix
```

elaine: Can we run a 10% canary for quantized-v2 today? Rollback criteria: p99 <= 260ms and error_rate not +>1% vs baseline.

jorge: Canary started — id abc123. Routing rule applied (10% traffic). Monitoring: https://dash.redwood/montclair/canary/abc123

metrics-bot: Canary metrics (10m window): p95 185ms (↗ 5ms), p99 248ms (↗ 8ms), error_rate 0.85% (↘ 0.05%). Tokens/min -6% WoW.

katie: Ill update renewal brief and include the canary notes + ask for docs on batching/5k token support.

elaine: Action items — sam: run batch/cache trial (ETA EOD); jorge: monitor canary + maintain rollback readiness; katie: update renewal notes + confirm Wed 4pm PT with customer; Ill send EOD recap. :thumbsup:
